Aucun compte. Tes plans de cours et tes notes sont traités sur ton iPhone et n’en sortent jamais. Utilise Apple Intelligence sur l’appareil, sur les iPhone compatibles.

en-GB.description:
StudyPlanner 2.2, now with Apple Intelligence.

Snap a syllabus and get your whole term: every deadline, your crunch weeks months ahead, and one clear move each day. On supported iPhones, Apple Intelligence does it on the device: private, offline, no account.

NEW: APPLE INTELLIGENCE ON YOUR IPHONE
• Reads tables, week grids and multi-page PDFs, and you confirm every row
• Picks what to study now and tells you why, on Today, your Lock Screen and Siri
• Writes flashcards and practice questions from your own notes, each citing its source line
• Turns "Lab report Friday, 10%" into a task you confirm once

SCAN EVERY CLASS, FREE
• Camera, PDF, pasted text or manual entry
• Tables, week grids and multi-page PDFs are read correctly
• Review every assignment, quiz and exam before anything is saved

CRUNCH FORECAST
• One term-wide heatmap across all your classes
• Red weeks show up months early, with dates like "start Bio on 12 Oct"
• Share your forecast as a card (class names hidden by default)

CLASS PACK
• Send a class's deadlines to classmates as a link or QR code
• They import the same dates in seconds, free, no scanning

ONE CLEAR MOVE A DAY
• Today, your Lock Screen widget and Siri agree: "Now: 25 min Bio ch. 7"
• Missed a session? The plan repairs itself
• Reminders before the dates that matter

EXAM MODE
• Turns your own notes into flashcards and practice questions, each citing the line it came from
• Works offline, with no credits or monthly caps
• Weak topics get extra revision before the exam
• Quiz Duel: challenge a friend with the same questions
Exam Mode is practice from your own notes. It doesn't answer homework or write assignments for you.

CAPTURE IN SECONDS
• Type or tell Siri "Lab report Friday, 10%", then confirm once
• Find classes and deadlines in Spotlight

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your syllabi and notes are processed on your iPhone and never leave it. Uses on-device Apple Intelligence on supported iPhones.

Smart extraction, daily briefs and quizzes use on-device Apple Intelligence on iPhone 15 Pro/Pro Max, iPhone 16 and 17 models and iPhone Air, with Apple Intelligence turned on, in supported languages and regions. Everything else works on iOS 16.4+.

FREE AND PLUS
Scanning, review, the Crunch Forecast, Class Pack import and playing a Quiz Duel you receive are free. Plans, Exam Mode, widgets and reminders require StudyPlanner Plus, an auto-renewing subscription that also unlocks Study Now and Siri. New subscribers can start with a free trial on the yearly or monthly plan. Cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

StudyPlanner doesn't connect to your school account or submit work, and nothing is added until you review it.

review.notes:
StudyPlanner 2.2.0 (build 95)

ON-DEVICE GENERATION: Smart syllabus extraction, the daily brief, practice questions and quick-add proposals use Apple's Foundation Models framework (SystemLanguageModel) on the device only. No server, no account, no third-party AI service, so guideline 5.1.2(i) third-party AI disclosure does not apply. Model output never writes planner data directly: every generated item is validated in code and shown to the user for review (Review Import screen or a confirm sheet) before it is saved. Exam Mode is practice from the user's own notes; each card and question cites the note line it came from. It does not solve homework.

ELIGIBLE DEVICE (iPhone 15 Pro or later, iOS 26+, Apple Intelligence on, a supported language such as English): items show a sparkles "Found on-device, verify" chip. INELIGIBLE DEVICE / AI off / iOS 16.4-25: the same screens use the classic on-device parser; the badge disappears. Both paths are fully functional.

FREE (no purchase): onboarding, scan (camera, PDF, paste, manual), review, the full Crunch Forecast and its share card, Class Pack import to review, and playing a received Quiz Duel. PLUS (auto-renewing subscription, prices loaded from StoreKit and shown with renewal terms on the paywall): applying the plan, Study Now, Exam Mode, widgets, reminders and Siri. Restore Purchases is on the paywall. Introductory offers: Yearly Plus 7-day free trial, Monthly Plus 3-day free trial, Weekly Plus $0.99 for the first week (eligible new subscribers only; StoreKit supplies eligibility and prices).

DEMO (no login needed): 1) Complete onboarding, choose Paste text. 2) Paste the SAMPLE SYLLABUS below. 3) Review the found items (edit any), then view the Crunch Forecast; the heaviest weeks (late Nov to mid Dec) are highlighted in red. 4) Tap Share on the Forecast card. 5) Subscribe in sandbox to apply the plan and see Today, widgets and Exam Mode (open a note of 400+ characters > Practice).
